children: Retractable Technologies, Inc. (“Retractable”) (NYSE American: RVP) announces its support for Senator Marsha Blackburn’s ONSHORE Manufacturing Act, legislation aimed at strengthening domestic production of critical medical supplies.
The legislation would provide tax incentives for U.S. manufacturing, including investments in advanced manufacturing equipment and facility modernization.

“The ONSHORE Manufacturing Act is the spark American manufacturers need to rebuild our domestic medical base. This legislation ensures that healthcare providers have uninterrupted access to safe, American-made medical products. We are proud to support Senator Blackburn’s efforts in safeguarding our public health infrastructure,” said Sarah Umandap, Government and Public Affairs department of Retractable Technologies, Inc.

Retractable Technologies has manufactured medical devices in Little Elm, Texas for decades while maintaining a global supply chain to support its product portfolio. The Company continues to invest in its domestic manufacturing capabilities while ensuring reliable access to critical medical products.
Retractable Technologies, Inc. looks forward to continuing to work with policymakers on efforts that strengthen American manufacturing and improve the resilience of the nation’s medical supply chain.
